text:
will: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — multiple external-dep symptoms last night (control-plane timeouts in two regions, model-registry 401 surge, and Okta throttling). Need owners, short-term mitigations and one preventative control per item. I'll create the ticket after this thread.

yasmin: I'll take the model-registry/auth fallout. Initial root cause looks like the token refresher crashed mid-KMS rotation, leaving fresh keys not propagated. Short-term: add a cached-token fallback that uses a last-known-good token for up to 10m and emit a specific metric on refresh failures. ETA: 4 business days. Preventative control: pre-rotation canary that rotates 1% of keys and validates refresh.

phil: I'll own cloud routing fallback and circuit-breaker behavior. Short-term: add a route-level failover list and lower the circuit-breaker trigger for control-plane error rates. ETA: 3 business days to ship policy + canary. Long-term: formal SLA escalation with provider and automated region-steering based on recent control-plane error rates.

meera: I'll do alert tagging + the monthly external-dep smoke job. Plan: tag related alerts with label external_dep=true, and create a smoke job that runs auth + registry flows. First run scheduled in 12 days. Also will add a regression-detection dashboard.

will: Ops-bot, create tracker and remind owners to paste checklist lines.

ops-bot: Tracker created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/EDRW-412 (title: vendor-dep-hardening). Owners: please add checklist items and timeboxes.

phil: Example policy snippet I'll PR: {"route":"generation","fallback":["gcp-us-central1","aws-us-east-1"],"circuit_breaker":{"error_rate":0.04,"window":"1m"}} — will include rollout plan (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%).

yasmin: Prometheus alert I plan to add for token problems:
alert: ModelRegistryTokenRefreshSpike
expr: increase(model_registry_token_refresh_failures[10m]) > 10
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: high

meera: For Okta throttling, short-term patch: capture x-rate-limit headers and backoff on 429 responses. ETA: 2 business days for the proxy logging change. Preventative control: per-tenant adaptive throttling to avoid bursty retries.

will: Short checklist I want in EDRW-412 (short-term = sprint / <=2w):
- [ ] yasmin — cached-token fallback + refresh alerting — ETA 4d — preventative: pre-rotation canary
- [ ] phil — routing failover + circuit-breaker config — ETA 3d — preventative: region-steer heuristics
- [ ] meera — alert tagging + monthly smoke job — ETA 12d — preventative: automated smoke alerts
- [ ] infra — KMS rotation audit (INFRA-842) — ETA 7d (assign infra)

yasmin: Claimed. I'll start a branch and include a simple fallback with metrics + a feature flag for canary. PR will include a rollback plan.

phil: I'll open the routing PR tomorrow with canary instructions. Canary plan: 5% for 1h -> 25% for 6h -> full if green. I'll add a quick monitor for increased latency in the canary window.

meera: Added the smoke job spec to the tracker and scheduled the first run. Also tagged the existing registry/auth alerts with external_dep=true.

will: Two final asks before I close: 1) each owner paste a one-line "what would have prevented this" to their checklist, 2) ensure PRs include canary & rollback steps. We'll review EDRW-412 in the weekly ops sync.

yasmin: Added preventative control line to ticket: "pre-rotation canary + healthcheck gate".

phil: Added: "automated region steering + provider SLA negotiation".

meera: Added: "monthly smoke job + regression alerts".

ops-bot: EDRW-412 updated with checklist and statuses. Next review scheduled at weekly ops sync.

will: Thanks all — closing thread. Update EDRW-412 with PR links and canary results before the sync. :thumbsup:
